title: Understanding the Model
text: The model is given by f(x)=theta_0+theta_1*veg+theta_2*(meat=beef)+theta_3*(meat=fish). For the third data point, identify the values of veg and meat.

title: Substitute Values into the Model
text: For the third data point, $$veg=2$$ and $$meat=beef$$. Substitute these values into the model equation.

title: Calculate the Predicted Total
text: Using the values $$\theta_0=-3$$, $$\theta_1=5$$, $$\theta_2=8$$, and $$\theta_3=12$$, calculate the predicted total for the third data point.

title: Calculate Absolute Loss
text: The actual total for the third data point is $$16$$. Calculate the absolute loss by finding the absolute value of the difference between the predicted total and the actual total.

title: Include L1 Regularization
text: Add the L1 regularization term to the absolute loss. The regularization term is $$\lambda \left(|\theta_0|+|\theta_1|+|\theta_2|+|\theta_3|\right)$$.
